hacks.title: DIY Corsi-Rosenthal Air Purifier Box
hacks.subtitle: High-Efficiency Low-Cost HEPA Alternative
hacks.efficacy: Cuts indoor PM2.5 by 85-92% within 30 minutes
supplies: 1x Cardboard shroud cutout for fan corners
steps: Create a cube using the four MERV 13 filters with arrows pointing inward toward the center.
Duct-tape all joints and corner seams tightly to prevent unpurified air bypass.
Tape cardboard sheet as the solid bottom base.
Place the 20-inch box fan on top, blowing air UPWARD into the room.
Cut a circular cardboard shroud around the fan blade circumference (increases airflow efficiency by 40%).
Run on low-medium speed for whisper-quiet continuous filtration.
hacks.impact: Delivers 400+ CADR (Clean Air Delivery Rate), matching expensive commercial hospital-grade purifiers at 1/6th the cost.

hacks.title: Solar-Thermal Ventilation Timing Protocol
hacks.subtitle: When to Open vs Seal Windows during Winter Smog
hacks.efficacy: Reduces indoor PM2.5 infiltration spikes by up to 60%
steps: NEVER ventilate between 5:30 AM and 10:30 AM: Cold air traps heavy pollutants at ground level during morning inversion.
Open opposite windows strictly between 1:00 PM and 3:30 PM: Solar heating breaks the inversion layer, dispersing particulates higher into the troposphere.
Execute 'Flash Ventilation' (5 to 10 minutes maximum) to exchange stale CO2 without freezing the house.
Damp mop hard floors immediately after to trap settled micro-particulates without resuspending dust.
Seal windows tightly before sunset (4:30 PM) as ground cools and smog layer falls back down.
hacks.impact: Keeps indoor CO2 below 900 ppm while avoiding peak toxic outdoor PM2.5 intrusion.

hacks.title: Indoor Cooking & Combustion Emissions Shield
hacks.subtitle: Stop Indoor Smog Multipliers
hacks.efficacy: Prevents indoor AQI from surging beyond 500+ inside the kitchen
supplies: Exhaust hood or kitchen exhaust fan
steps: Always turn on exhaust fans 2 minutes BEFORE lighting a gas burner and leave running 5 minutes after.
Cover pots with tight-fitting lids; switch from high-heat deep frying to boiling/steaming during severe smog days.
Eliminate indoor combustion: zero incense sticks (agarbatti), zero scented paraffin candles, and zero wood-burning hearths.
Use electric kettle or induction plate when possible to avoid NO2 and formaldehyde byproducts from methane combustion.
hacks.impact: Avoids creating an indoor pollution hotspot that can be 4x more toxic than outdoor air.

hacks.title: Bio-Filtration with Top NASA Houseplants
hacks.subtitle: Natural Oxygenation & VOC Absorption
hacks.efficacy: Absorbs formaldehyde, benzene, and replenishes indoor oxygen safely
steps: Place Snake Plants in bedrooms: unlike most plants, they release oxygen at night (Crassulacean Acid Metabolism).
Keep Areca Palms in living rooms for natural humidity buffering in dry winter heated air.
Wipe plant leaves monthly with a damp cloth so leaf stomata remain unblocked by micro-dust.
Note: Keep Peace Lily out of reach of curious cats and dogs (non-pet friendly); Spider Plants are 100% pet-safe.
hacks.impact: Improves indoor air feel, psychological well-being, and bio-filters trace organic compounds.

hacks.title: Personal Exposure Defenses & Fit Testing
hacks.subtitle: N95/FFP2 Optimization & Draft Elimination
hacks.efficacy: Cuts inhaled PM2.5 by 95% on commutes
supplies: Certified N95 / FFP2 / KF94 respirators (headband preferred over earloops)
steps: Ensure respirator creates an airtight seal: perform positive/negative seal check with each wearing.
Cloth masks and surgical masks DO NOT filter sub-2.5 micron particles (they allow 70%+ particulate bypass).
Apply weatherstrip tape along loose door jambs and exterior window crevices.
Place rolled towel or silicone sweep along bedroom doors facing main stairwells or outdoor balconies.
hacks.impact: Directly safeguards vulnerable pulmonary alveoli from micro-soot penetration.
